---
title: "Translate the pretraining corpus to amino acids"
---

```{r packages}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(igblastr)
```

```{r read in data}

div_data <- read_csv(data_path("foundation/diverse_foundation_data.csv"))

```

```{r convert to protein}

#install_IMGT_germline_db('202531-1', force = T)
use_germline_db("IMGT-202531-1.Homo_sapiens.IGH+IGK+IGL")
use_c_region_db("_IMGT.human.IGH+IGK+IGL.202412")

seqs <- DNAStringSet(div_data$`0`)
names(seqs) <- rep(1, nrow(div_data))

# Run igblastn
igblast_results <- 
  igblastn(
  query = seqs,
  organism = "human",
  outfmt = "AIRR",
  num_threads=14,
  num_alignments_V=1,
  num_alignments_C=1
)

```

```{r save}

igblast_results %>% 
  filter(str_detect(sequence_aa, 'X', negate = T)) %>%
  select(sequence_aa) %>%
  write_tsv(data_path("foundation/diverse_foundation_data_protein.csv"))

df <- read_tsv(data_path("foundation/diverse_foundation_data_protein.csv"))

write_tsv(df, data_path("foundation/diverse_foundation_data_protein_nohead.csv"), append = T) #no header
```
